reference_runner: controlled licensed reference environment; not yet executed
cueglint_runner: Signed native macOS single-window implementation ran on an original changed-marker fixture. Live transcript and display scenarios remain open. Linux X11 uses .github/scripts/linux-screen-context-fixture.sh with a private Xvfb server. Pass an installed local model directory through CUEGLINT_SCREEN_FIXTURE_MODELS for two generated answers with fresh context.
preconditions: Original screen fixture with two distinguishable facts
actions: Change a known visible fact between questions; assert the intended capture/revision is used.
tolerances: Contract-specific values in features.yaml; ASR/model thresholds must be fixed before running.
linux_criteria: Two requests in one session use the same question and display ID. Each capture has its own UUID.
Changing the authored marker or only the background changes the PNG hash. An untouched second display keeps the same hash.
Each saved frozen capture has the expected exact marker after normalization, its own capture timestamp and no other authored marker. A foreign explicit display ID fails.
Both generated answers must contain their current three words and neither excluded marker. The prior answer remains in the second request history.
After setup, the isolated network namespace has only loopback, no default routes and identical before/after byte and packet counters.
